compiled_state.title: Implement coordination-pass dispatch: gov-copy-writer second-pass receives first-pass rationale
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3 (c5ef): the coordination-pass dispatch receives the full first-pass rationale (rule_ids, conflicts, deviations) as input

## Description
Implement the coordination-pass dispatch path in sprint orchestration (likely plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md or a dedicated script). When a coordination-pass child task is executed:
1. Read the first-pass artifact at <copy.artifact_dir>/<epic-id>.yaml (produced by gov-copy-writer in the parent copy story task)
2. Snapshot the artifact to a stable input file (avoid race with first-pass output)
3. Dispatch gov-copy-writer in second-pass mode, passing the full first-pass rationale (per-item rule_ids, conflicts, deviations) as additional input context
4. gov-copy-writer second-pass produces an updated artifact at the same path; downstream diff-check (T3) enforces immutability on hard-constraint items

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a first-pass artifact produced by gov-copy-writer with non-empty rationale (rule_ids, conflicts, deviations); When the coordination-pass dispatch runs; Then gov-copy-writer's second-pass invocation receives the first-pass rationale verbatim as input context, and the second-pass artifact's items each preserve or reference the first-pass rule_ids citation (rationale traceability).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Coordination-pass dispatch implementation exists
  Verify: grep -rq 'coordination-pass' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/ plugins/dso/scripts/
- [ ] gov-copy-writer second-pass receives full first-pass rationale
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-coordination-pass-dispatch.sh
- [ ] Snapshot-based input avoids race condition
  Verify: grep -qE 'snapshot|stable' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md plugins/dso/scripts/*coordination*
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-coordination-pass-dispatch.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index
